_about: Motivations, secrets, regrets and hopes. 'align' limits an entry to heroes or villains; untagged entries suit anyone. Original content written for DCUGen.

motivations.text: Keeping the promise made at a graveside.
Proving the neighborhood that raised {them} produces more than criminals.
Making sure no other kid goes through what {name} went through.
Paying back a debt of kindness that can never really be repaid.
Showing that power can be used gently.
Atoning for a past {they} won't talk about.
Being the kind of person {their} childhood hero would be proud of.
Protecting {hometown}, the place that made {them}.
Standing up for people the system has written off.
Finding out what really happened, whatever it costs.
Holding the powerful to the same rules as everyone else.
Earning the trust of the people who still fear {them}.
The simple conviction that if you can help, you must.
Proving a parent's faith in {them} was not misplaced.
Never again standing by while someone else gets hurt.
Taking what the world refused to give.
Making the people who laughed at {them} afraid instead.
Tearing down a system that only ever served the rich.
Proving {they_are} smarter than every so-called hero.
Revenge on the hero who ruined {their} life.
Building an empire nobody can take away.
Securing enough money that {their} family never goes hungry again.
Testing limits, {their} own and everyone else's.
Making the city remember {their} name.
Getting back what was stolen, with interest.
Order, imposed by force if necessary.
The thrill; nothing else makes {them} feel alive.
Loyalty to a boss who once saved {their} life.
Proving that heroes are hypocrites.
A twisted love that will not take no for an answer.
Finding the truth about {their} own past.
Earning enough respect that nobody can dismiss {them} again.
Protecting the people {they+love}, no matter what.
Curiosity about the strange world that keeps intruding.
Being the best at something, anything.
Getting out from under a debt.
Living up to a family name, or living it down.
Escaping the life {they_were} born into.
Finding somewhere to belong.
Simple survival, one day at a time.
Faith, and the duty that comes with it.
Knowledge, and the power that comes with it.
A love affair {they} cannot let go of.
Restoring a family fortune that slipped away.
Making a mark the history books can't ignore.
Fixing one terrible mistake.
Freedom from anyone's control.
Keeping a dangerous secret buried.

secrets: Is not legally who {they+claim} to be; the identity was bought years ago.
Has a child {they+have} never met.
Was once a henchman for a minor costumed villain.
Cheated on an exam that launched {their} entire career.
Knows where a body is buried, literally.
Has a gambling debt to people who don't send letters.
Is in love with a best friend's spouse.
Sends money every month to the family of someone {they} hurt.
Has a sealed juvenile record for something serious.
Once let a guilty person go free for money.
Can't actually read very well and has hidden it for decades.
Has been in therapy for years and tells no one.
Faked {their} own death once, briefly, to escape a bad situation.
Knows a hero's secret identity.
Has been passing information to a reporter about {their} employer.
Is working off a debt to a villain, one small favor at a time.
Still has the gun from the night everything went wrong.
Is quietly being treated for a serious illness.
Lied on a sworn statement that put someone in prison.
Keeps a go-bag and a fake passport behind a loose wall panel.
Was the anonymous source in a story that ruined someone innocent.
Has had dreams that came true, three times.
Was offered powers once and turned them down; or so {they+say}.
Has a sibling in witness protection.
Stole a single strange artifact from a crime scene and kept it.
Is secretly broke and keeping up appearances.
Once worked for {company} on a project that hurt people.
Has a second phone that nobody knows about.
Is related by blood to a famous villain.
Was blackmailed into planting evidence once.
Remembers a life before {their} own birth, in detail.
Saw a hero commit murder and never reported it.
Hasn't paid taxes in eleven years.
Wrote anonymous hate mail to a hero during a dark period.
Is the reason a family friend went to prison.
Can't remember six months of {their} life, and the gap has records attached.
regrets: Not saying goodbye to {their} {parent}.
Choosing a career over a relationship that mattered.
Walking away from a fight that someone else had to finish.
A cruel thing said in anger to {sibling}.
Not going to college when the chance was there.
Trusting the wrong person with a secret.
Taking the money.
Not taking the money.
Ignoring a friend's call for help.
Staying silent when it was time to speak up.
Leaving {hometown} without looking back.
Never learning {their} grandparents' language.
Breaking a promise to a child.
Choosing revenge over mercy, once.
The person {they} hurt on the way up.
Being too proud to apologize.
Wasting years being angry.
Not reporting something {they} saw.
Selling something that could never be bought back.
Lying under oath.
Letting a mentor die believing {name} had given up.
Missing the birth of a child.
The night {they} drove when {they} shouldn't have.
Giving up music, art or sport for something 'sensible.'
Letting a friend take the blame.
Not fighting harder for a marriage.
Turning away someone who needed a place to stay.
Underestimating a villain, once, with consequences.
Following orders that {they} knew were wrong.
Running away when {they_were} needed.
Nothing; or so {they+insist}.
hopes: A quiet house with a garden and nobody shooting at anyone.
Seeing {sibling} happy and safe.
Making it right with {their} {parent} before it's too late.
A family of {their} own.
Being remembered as one of the good ones.
Clearing {their} name.
Finding the person who did it.
One day owning the building {they} grew up in.
A real vacation somewhere warm.
Teaching what {they+know} to someone who needs it.
Retiring before the work kills {them}.
Learning the truth about {their} birth.
Being trusted by the heroes {they} once worshiped.
Going back to school.
Finding love that survives the truth.
Being forgiven.
Making enough to never worry about rent again.
Writing it all down someday.
Seeing {hometown} rebuilt.
Winning, just once, against the rival.
Getting sober and staying that way.
Seeing the stars from somewhere other than Earth.
A city where nobody needs masks.
Opening a {gym|diner|clinic|bookshop} of {their} own.
Earning a parent's pride.
Getting a dog.
Being normal, just for a little while.
Ruling the city, openly and without apology.
Making peace with an enemy.
Finding a mentor who vanished.
